generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can look internally ready when normative list items are compressed or when a result-only publication carries hidden parent lineage.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Validate only aggregate test success and one matching parent SHA without proving atomic requirements and single-parent topology.
generalized_learning.reusable_control: Require atomic obligation-to-control mapping and single-parent direct result-child verification before handoff.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Build closure from every normative list item and create result-only publication with exactly one material parent.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Rederive atomic specification coverage and inspect parent count plus complete child delta at the terminal gate.

transfer_cases.case: plain normative bullets without modal verbs
result commit with one matching parent plus an additional parent

skill_changes.evidence: Current delivery contract requires per-obligation controls and direct result-only child publication.
Current terminal and saturation contracts require specification rederivation, direct parent validation and allowlist verification.
